data.title: 神罚 · 细雨午后的慵懒被窝
data.description: 窗外细雨蒙蒙打在微凉的玻璃上，昏暗温暖的卧室内弥漫着静谧香气。神罚身穿浅灰色落肩针织短裙，雪白柔顺的短发略显凌乱，单肩滑落露出精致白皙的锁骨与香肩。她蜷坐在柔软白被间，微红着双颊抱膝凝望镜头，深红色的眼眸中满是纯真的依恋与少女的隐秘娇羞。
data.location: dimly lit cozy bedroom with rain on window
data.action: 身穿浅灰色落肩针织短裙，雪白柔顺的短发略显凌乱
data.lighting: soft diffused rainy daylight from window mixed with warm bedside glow
data.promptProse: Curled on white bedsheets on a quiet rainy afternoon, Modernia hugs her knees in a soft pale-grey off-shoulder ribbed knit sweater dress with long sleeves revealing her bare collarbone. With pleasantly tousled silver hair and a soft, devoted blush, she sits between rainy window light and warm bedside glow.
data.animaCaption: Sitting curled on white bedsheets hugging her knees in a soft grey off-shoulder ribbed sweater dress, she looks toward the viewer with tousled hair and a warm, devoted blush. Rain-streaked afternoon window light blends gently with the bedside lamp.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a soft pale-grey ribbed knit off-shoulder sweater dress with relaxed long sleeves exposing her bare collarbone and shoulders.
